critical_code_review_comments: backend routes/bar_games.py:433 — gift_perk raises HTTPException(400, {code: f'perk_{status}' ...}) but the fallback 'invalid' branch is only used when status == 'valid', which is unreachable (guarded by the same line's != check). The `else 'invalid'` clause is dead code — cosmetic.

backend routes/bar_games.py:459 — POST /cover-art has no per-business ownership check. Any authenticated user can generate cover art. Since the endpoint is also reused for user-tier rate-limiting via image_gen.generate() this is likely intended, but note there's no scoping to 'owner of a bar' — a free user could burn a bar-tier art credit even if they can't schedule a live event.

frontend BarStaffScan.jsx:39 — after a successful redeem, the local `result.status` flips to 'redeemed' and the scan-redeem button correctly disappears. But the toast says 'Perk redeemed 🍸' regardless of whether the second click was actually the burn or a stale button — because the button is only removed on the setResult after the response. Fine in practice (async click debounce via `busy` flag), just noting for defensive UX.
